package app

// The M3c end-to-end scenario (Task 5): the generated to-do app served in-process by Serve
// through httptest, driven by an http.Client with a cookie jar that does not follow redirects,
// so every 303 is observed. internal/gen's TestE2E_Todos writes this file into the module the
// app is emitted to and runs it.

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"html"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/cookiejar"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"alder/rt"
	"alder/rt/db"
)

// e2ePassword is a stub Auth.Login.Password that mirrors the dev adapter
// (examples/todos/adapters): a@b.c (and a second user, b@b.c) with "pw" is the id of a User row
// it finds or creates in the running Task's transaction. boom@b.c inserts a User row in that transaction and then fails
// (the row must be rolled back); probe@b.c counts the boom@b.c rows and, as a positive control,
// the a@b.c rows, and records both counts.
// Every call is recorded.
type e2ePassword struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	calls  []string
	probes []int
}

var _ Cap__Auth__Login__Password = (*e2ePassword)(nil)

func (p *e2ePassword) Verify(ctx context.Context, args Args__Auth__Login__Password__Verify) (rt.Maybe[string], error) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.calls = append(p.calls, args.Email)
	p.mu.Unlock()
	switch {
	case (args.Email == "a@b.c" || args.Email == "b@b.c") && args.Password == "pw":
		id, err := e2eUser(ctx, args.Email)
		if err != nil {
			return rt.Nothing[string](), err
		}
		return rt.Just(id), nil
	case args.Email == "boom@b.c":
		if _, err := e2eUser(ctx, args.Email); err != nil {
			return rt.Nothing[string](), err
		}
		return rt.Nothing[string](), errors.New("password service down")
	case args.Email == "probe@b.c":
		rows, err := e2eUsers(ctx, "boom@b.c")
		if err != nil {
			return rt.Nothing[string](), err
		}
		// the positive control: a@b.c's committed row must be seen the same way
		control, err := e2eUsers(ctx, "a@b.c")
		if err != nil {
			return rt.Nothing[string](), err
		}
		p.mu.Lock()
		p.probes = append(p.probes, len(rows), len(control))
		p.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return rt.Nothing[string](), nil
}

func (p *e2ePassword) callCount() int {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	return len(p.calls)
}

// e2eUsers are the User rows with email, read in the running Task's transaction.
func e2eUsers(ctx context.Context, email string) ([][]any, error) {
	st, tx := db.StoreFrom(ctx), db.TxFrom(ctx)
	if st == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("e2e: the context carries no store")
	}
	users := table__Table__User__User.Desc()
	return st.Query(ctx, tx, users.Name, users.Columns, db.Where(db.CEq("email", email), db.From(table__Table__User__User)).SQL())
}

// e2eUser finds or creates the User row with email (as the dev adapter's devUser does).
func e2eUser(ctx context.Context, email string) (string, error) {
	rows, err := e2eUsers(ctx, email)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	users := table__Table__User__User.Desc()
	if len(rows) > 0 {
		for i, c := range users.Columns {
			if c.Name == users.ID {
				return db.DecodeText(rows[0][i])
			}
		}
	}
	vals := insertvals__Table__User__User(insert__Table__User__User{Email: email, Name: "Ann", PasswordHash: ""})
	return db.InsertRow(ctx, db.StoreFrom(ctx), db.TxFrom(ctx), table__Table__User__User, vals, time.Now())
}

// e2e is a running app and a browser-like client (cookie jar, no redirect following).
type e2e struct {
	t    *testing.T
	srv  *httptest.Server
	c    *http.Client
	caps *e2ePassword
}

type e2eResp struct {
	status int
	header http.Header
	body   string
}

// browser is another browser (its own cookie jar) on the same running app.
func (e *e2e) browser() *e2e {
	jar, err := cookiejar.New(nil)
	if err != nil {
		e.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c := &http.Client{Jar: jar, Timeout: e.c.Timeout, CheckRedirect: e.c.CheckRedirect}
	return &e2e{t: e.t, srv: e.srv, c: c, caps: e.caps}
}

func newE2E(t *testing.T, dev bool) *e2e {
	t.Helper()
	caps := &e2ePassword{}
	h, err := Serve(Caps{Auth__Login__Password: caps}, Options{DB: ":memory:", Dev: dev, Secret: []byte("test-secret-0123456789")})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	srv := httptest.NewServer(h)
	t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
	jar, err := cookiejar.New(nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c := &http.Client{Jar: jar, Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
		CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
	return &e2e{t: t, srv: srv, c: c, caps: caps}
}

// do sends a request; form (when not nil) is the url-encoded body; hdr are "Name: value" pairs.
func (e *e2e) do(method, path string, form url.Values, hdr ...string) e2eResp {
	e.t.Helper()
	var body io.Reader
	if form != nil {
		body = strings.NewReader(form.Encode())
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequest(method, e.srv.URL+path, body)
	if err != nil {
		e.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if form != nil {
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")
	}
	for _, h := range hdr {
		k, v, _ := strings.Cut(h, ": ")
		req.Header.Set(k, v)
	}
	res, err := e.c.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		e.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	b, err := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
	if err != nil {
		e.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	r := e2eResp{status: res.StatusCode, header: res.Header, body: string(b)}
	e.t.Logf("%s %s → %d %s Location=%q Set-Cookie=%q body[%d]", method, path, r.status, r.header.Get("Content-Type"), r.header.Get("Location"), r.header.Get("Set-Cookie"), len(r.body))
	return r
}

// session is the session stored in the jar's alder_session cookie (its payload: base64url
// JSON before the "."), decoded with the app's codec, and the raw JSON.
func (e *e2e) session() (App__Session, string) {
	e.t.Helper()
	u, _ := url.Parse(e.srv.URL)
	for _, c := range e.c.Jar.Cookies(u) {
		if c.Name == "alder_session" {
			return decodeCookie(e.t, c.Value)
		}
	}
	e.t.Fatal("no alder_session cookie in the jar")
	return App__Session{}, ""
}

// decodeCookie decodes the cookie value v: its signed payload (base64url before the ".") is
// {"iss": <unix seconds>, "session": <the codec's JSON>}; it returns the session and its JSON.
// The issued time must be about now (the cookie expires 30 days after it).
func decodeCookie(t *testing.T, v string) (App__Session, string) {
	t.Helper()
	_, raw := cookiePayload(t, v)
	var env struct {
		Iss     int64           `json:"iss"`
		Session json.RawMessage `json:"session"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &env); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("cookie payload %s: %v", raw, err)
	}
	if d := time.Since(time.Unix(env.Iss, 0)); d < -time.Minute || d > time.Minute {
		t.Fatalf("cookie payload %s: issued %v ago, want now", raw, d)
	}
	s, err := session__codec{}.Decode(env.Session)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("cookie payload %s: %v", raw, err)
	}
	return s.(App__Session), string(env.Session)
}

// cookiePayload splits the cookie value v into its signature part and its decoded payload.
func cookiePayload(t *testing.T, v string) (sig string, payload []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	p, sig, ok := strings.Cut(v, ".")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("cookie %q has no signature", v)
	}
	raw, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(p)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("cookie payload %q: %v", p, err)
	}
	return sig, raw
}

func (r e2eResp) want(t *testing.T, status int, frags ...string) {
	t.Helper()
	if r.status != status {
		t.Fatalf("status %d, want %d; body:\n%s", r.status, status, r.body)
	}
	for _, f := range frags {
		if !strings.Contains(r.body, f) {
			t.Fatalf("body lacks %q:\n%s", f, r.body)
		}
	}
}

func (r e2eResp) lacks(t *testing.T, frags ...string) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, f := range frags {
		if strings.Contains(r.body, f) {
			t.Fatalf("body has %q:\n%s", f, r.body)
		}
	}
}

func (r e2eResp) redirect(t *testing.T, loc string) {
	t.Helper()
	if r.status != http.StatusSeeOther || r.header.Get("Location") != loc {
		t.Fatalf("got %d Location %q, want 303 %q; body:\n%s", r.status, r.header.Get("Location"), loc, r.body)
	}
	if r.body != "" {
		t.Fatalf("303 with a body: %q", r.body)
	}
}

// navigate checks a Datastar redirect to a page of this app (C1, M13): status 200, no Location
// header (the client's fetch would follow it), and the target page served by the router itself:
// the patch of its body, then a self-removing script pushing loc (a JSON string) to the history.
func (r e2eResp) navigate(t *testing.T, loc string) {
	t.Helper()
	j, _ := json.Marshal(loc)
	push := `<script data-effect="el.remove()">(function(){var u=` + string(j) + `;`
	if r.status != http.StatusOK || r.header.Get("Content-Type") != "text/event-stream" || r.header.Get("Location") != "" ||
		!strings.HasPrefix(r.body, "event: datastar-patch-elements\ndata: selector body\ndata: mode outer\ndata: elements <body>") || !strings.Contains(r.body, push) {
		t.Fatalf("got %d %q Location %q body:\n%q\nwant the page at %s morphed in, then %s", r.status, r.header.Get("Content-Type"), r.header.Get("Location"), r.body, loc, push)
	}
}

func (r e2eResp) html(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	if ct := r.header.Get("Content-Type"); ct != "text/html; charset=utf-8" {
		t.Fatalf("Content-Type %q, want text/html; charset=utf-8", ct)
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(r.body, "<!doctype html>\n<html") {
		t.Fatalf("not a full document: %.80q", r.body)
	}
}

// sse checks a Datastar body patch: status 200, an event stream of one
// datastar-patch-elements event replacing <body>.
func (r e2eResp) sse(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	if r.status != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("status %d, want 200; body:\n%s", r.status, r.body)
	}
	if ct := r.header.Get("Content-Type"); ct != "text/event-stream" {
		t.Fatalf("Content-Type %q, want text/event-stream", ct)
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(r.body, "event: datastar-patch-elements\ndata: selector body\ndata: mode outer\ndata: elements <body>") || !strings.HasSuffix(r.body, "</body>\n\n") {
		t.Fatalf("not a body patch:\n%s", r.body)
	}
}

// cookieSet checks r stores the session: Set-Cookie alder_session=…; Path=/; HttpOnly;
// SameSite=Lax, and returns its decoded session.
func (r e2eResp) cookieSet(t *testing.T) (App__Session, string) {
	t.Helper()
	sc := r.header.Get("Set-Cookie")
	if !strings.HasPrefix(sc, "alder_session=") {
		t.Fatalf("Set-Cookie %q, want alder_session", sc)
	}
	for _, a := range []string{"; Path=/", "; HttpOnly", "; SameSite=Lax", "; Max-Age=2592000"} {
		if !strings.Contains(sc, a) {
			t.Fatalf("Set-Cookie %q lacks %q", sc, a)
		}
	}
	v, _, _ := strings.Cut(strings.TrimPrefix(sc, "alder_session="), ";")
	return decodeCookie(t, v)
}

func (r e2eResp) noCookie(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	if sc := r.header.Get("Set-Cookie"); sc != "" {
		t.Fatalf("Set-Cookie %q, want none", sc)
	}
}

const datastarHdr = "Datastar-Request: true"

// msgRef matches the message URLs a page renders: form actions and Datastar @post(…) clicks.
var msgRef = regexp.MustCompile(`(?:action="|@post\(&#39;)(/_m/[^"]*?)(?:"|&#39;)`)

// msgURL is the first message URL in body whose path is path and, when id is not "", whose
// query's id is id. The test posts to the URLs the page renders, never hand-built ones: a page
// message carries what the page needs in its URL (no Referer is sent for page messages).
func msgURL(t *testing.T, body, path, id string) string {
	t.Helper()
	for _, m := range msgRef.FindAllStringSubmatch(body, -1) {
		raw := html.UnescapeString(m[1])
		u, err := url.Parse(raw)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("message URL %q: %v", raw, err)
		}
		if u.Path == path && (id == "" || u.Query().Get("id") == id) {
			return raw
		}
	}
	t.Fatalf("no message URL %s (id %q) in:\n%s", path, id, body)
	return ""
}

// login logs a@b.c in (step 4) through the login page's form and returns the user id the
// cookie holds.
func (e *e2e) login(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	return e.loginAs(t, "a@b.c")
}

// loginAs logs email in through the login page's form and returns the user id the cookie holds.
func (e *e2e) loginAs(t *testing.T, email string) string {
	t.Helper()
	submit := msgURL(t, e.do("GET", "/login", nil).body, "/_m/Auth.Login/Submit", "")
	r := e.do("POST", submit, url.Values{"email": {email}, "password": {"pw"}})
	r.redirect(t, "/")
	s, raw := r.cookieSet(t)
	if !s.User.Ok || s.User.Val == "" {
		t.Fatalf("session after login: %s", raw)
	}
	return s.User.Val
}

var todoHref = regexp.MustCompile(`<a href="/todos/([^"]+)">Milk</a>`)

func TestE2E_RequiresUnderDatastar(t *testing.T) {
	e := newE2E(t, true)
	// requires user, logged out, under Datastar: an event navigating to the login page (a 303
	// would be followed inside the client's fetch, leaving the address bar at /)
	r := e.do("GET", "/", nil, datastarHdr)
	r.navigate(t, "/login")
	// a message of a requires page too
	r = e.do("POST", "/_m/Todos.Index/Toggle?id=x", nil, datastarHdr)
	r.navigate(t, "/login")
	// without Datastar: the 303
	e.do("POST", "/_m/Todos.Index/Toggle?id=x", nil).redirect(t, "/login")
}

func TestE2E_Todos(t *testing.T) {
	e := newE2E(t, true)

	// 1. logged out: / → 303 /login (also under Datastar: TestE2E_RequiresUnderDatastar)
	r := e.do("GET", "/", nil)
	r.redirect(t, "/login")

	// 2. the login page
	r = e.do("GET", "/login", nil)
	r.want(t, 200,
		`<form method="post" action="/_m/Auth.Login/Submit`,
		`type="password"`, `name="password"`, `<input name="email" type="email" required />`,
		`<script type="module" src="/_alder/datastar-v1.0.0.js"></script>`,
		`<title>Log in</title>`, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="form"></ul>`)
	r.html(t)
	// a visitor's session is the default: nothing to store (the cookie is stored only when a
	// response changes the session or runs Session.put)
	r.noCookie(t)
	loginSubmit := msgURL(t, r.body, "/_m/Auth.Login/Submit", "")

	// 3. wrong password: Reject on the form, the password not echoed
	r = e.do("POST", loginSubmit, url.Values{"email": {"a@b.c"}, "password": {"hunter2"}})
	r.want(t, 200, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="form"><li>Email or password is incorrect.</li></ul>`, `value="a@b.c"`)
	r.html(t)
	r.lacks(t, "hunter2")
	if n := e.caps.callCount(); n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("Verify called %d times, want 1", n)
	}
	// an invalid email: a field error, update (and so Verify) not called
	r = e.do("POST", loginSubmit, url.Values{"email": {"x"}, "password": {"hunter2"}})
	r.want(t, 200, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="email" id="errors-email"><li>must be an email address</li></ul>`, `aria-describedby="errors-email"`, `value="x"`, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="form"></ul>`)
	r.lacks(t, "hunter2")
	r.noCookie(t)
	if n := e.caps.callCount(); n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("Verify called %d times after a form error, want 1 (update must not run)", n)
	}

	// 4. login: under Datastar an event navigating to / with the session cookie; without, a 303
	r = e.do("POST", loginSubmit, url.Values{"email": {"a@b.c"}, "password": {"pw"}}, datastarHdr)
	r.navigate(t, "/")
	if s, raw := r.cookieSet(t); !s.User.Ok {
		t.Fatalf("session after a Datastar login: %s", raw)
	}
	uid := e.login(t)

	// 5. the empty list; the filter link marked current
	r = e.do("GET", "/", nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `<h1>Todos</h1>`, `<form method="post" action="/_m/Todos.Index/Submit`, `name="title"`, `<ul id="todos"></ul>`, `<p id="summary">0 open</p>`,
		`<a href="/" aria-current="page">All</a>`, `<a href="/?filter=Active">Active</a>`)
	r.html(t)
	// a page view leaves the session as it was: no Set-Cookie, so the cookie keeps the time it
	// was issued at login (no sliding renewal)
	r.noCookie(t)
	if s, _ := e.session(); s.User.Val != uid {
		t.Fatalf("the jar's user %q, want %q", s.User.Val, uid)
	}
	submit := msgURL(t, r.body, "/_m/Todos.Index/Submit", "")
	r = e.do("GET", "/?filter=Active", nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `<a href="/?filter=Active" aria-current="page">Active</a>`, `<a href="/">All</a>`)
	r = e.do("GET", "/?filter=Nope", nil)
	r.want(t, 404, `<h1>Not found</h1>`)

	// 6. form errors re-render with the values; a valid todo redirects
	r = e.do("POST", submit, url.Values{"title": {""}})
	r.want(t, 200, `<al-input label="What needs doing?" invalid>`, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="title" id="errors-title"><li>must not be empty</li></ul>`, `<ul id="todos"></ul>`)
	r.html(t)
	r.noCookie(t)
	r = e.do("POST", submit, url.Values{"title": {"Milk"}, "due": {"2026-13-01"}})
	r.want(t, 200, `<ul class="errors" data-errors="due" id="errors-due"><li>must be a date (YYYY-MM-DD)</li></ul>`, `value="Milk"`, `value="2026-13-01"`, `<ul id="todos"></ul>`)
	r.lacks(t, `data-errors="title" id="errors-title"><li>`)
	r = e.do("POST", submit, url.Values{"title": {"Milk"}, "due": {"2026-10-12"}}, datastarHdr)
	r.navigate(t, "/")
	r.noCookie(t) // the update did not change the session
	r = e.do("GET", "/", nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `<al-badge variant="outline" class="due">Oct 12</al-badge>`, `<p id="summary">1 open</p>`)
	m := todoHref.FindAllStringSubmatch(r.body, -1)
	if len(m) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d Milk rows, want 1:\n%s", len(m), r.body)
	}
	id := m[0][1]
	toggle := msgURL(t, r.body, "/_m/Todos.Index/Toggle", id)
	// a click button works without JavaScript: a form of its own posting the message, which
	// Datastar posts on submit
	q := url.QueryEscape(id)
	r.want(t, 200, `<li class=""><form method="post" action="/_m/Todos.Index/Toggle?id=`+q+`" class="_alder-click" data-on:submit="window._alderAC?.abort();(window._alderBusy||((e,p)=&gt;p))(el, @post(&#39;/_m/Todos.Index/Toggle?id=`+q+`&#39;, {contentType: &#39;form&#39;, requestCancellation: window._alderAC = new AbortController()}))"><al-button variant="secondary" size="sm"><button type="submit">Done</button></al-button></form>`)

	// 7. Toggle under Datastar: an SSE patch of <body> with the toggled row; without: a 303 to the
	// page
	r = e.do("POST", toggle, nil, datastarHdr)
	r.sse(t)
	for _, f := range []string{
		`<ul id="todos"><li class="done"><form method="post" action="/_m/Todos.Index/Toggle?id=` + q + `" class="_alder-click"`,
		`>Undo</button></al-button></form><a href="/todos/` + id + `">Milk</a>`,
		`<p id="summary">0 open</p>`,
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(r.body, f) {
			t.Fatalf("patch lacks %q:\n%s", f, r.body)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(r.body, "<head>") || strings.Contains(r.body, "<!doctype") {
		t.Fatalf("patch carries the document:\n%s", r.body)
	}
	r.noCookie(t)
	// from the Completed view (the todo is done), without JavaScript: the browser posts the
	// click button's form; the Rerender is a 303 back to the page (Post/Redirect/Get), which
	// shows the toggle
	r = e.do("GET", "/?filter=Completed", nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `>Undo</button>`)
	toggle = msgURL(t, r.body, "/_m/Todos.Index/Toggle", id)
	r = e.do("POST", toggle, url.Values{})
	r.redirect(t, "/?filter=Completed")
	r.noCookie(t)
	t.Run("RerenderKeepsFilter", func(t *testing.T) {
		if !strings.Contains(toggle, "_p.filter=Completed") {
			t.Fatalf("the Toggle URL does not carry the page's filter: %s", toggle)
		}
		r := e.do("GET", "/?filter=Completed", nil)
		r.want(t, 200, `<a href="/?filter=Completed" aria-current="page">Completed</a>`, `<ul id="todos"></ul>`, `<p id="summary">0 open</p>`)
	})
	r = e.do("GET", "/", nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `<li class=""><form`, `>Done</button></al-button></form><a href="/todos/`+id+`">Milk</a>`, `<p id="summary">1 open</p>`)
	r = e.do("GET", "/?filter=Completed", nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `<ul id="todos"></ul>`)

	// 8. the todo's page; an unknown id is 404
	r = e.do("GET", "/todos/"+url.PathEscape(id), nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `<title>Milk</title>`, `<h1>Milk</h1>`, `value="Milk"`, `value="2026-10-12"`, `<a href="/">Back</a>`)
	r.html(t)
	r = e.do("GET", "/todos/nope", nil)
	r.want(t, 404, `<title>Not found</title>`, `<h1>Not found</h1>`)
	r.html(t)

	// 9. Delete (from the list, under Datastar): the patched list is empty, and stays empty
	r = e.do("GET", "/", nil)
	del := msgURL(t, r.body, "/_m/Todos.Index/Delete", id)
	r = e.do("POST", del, nil, datastarHdr)
	r.sse(t)
	r.want(t, 200, `<ul id="todos"></ul>`, `<p id="summary">0 open</p>`)
	r.lacks(t, "Milk")
	r = e.do("GET", "/", nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `<ul id="todos"></ul>`)
	r.lacks(t, "Milk")
	r = e.do("GET", "/todos/"+url.PathEscape(id), nil)
	r.want(t, 404, `<h1>Not found</h1>`)

	// 10. a create without Datastar: the 303 (step 6 sent the header)
	r = e.do("POST", submit, url.Values{"title": {"Bread"}})
	r.redirect(t, "/")
	r = e.do("GET", "/", nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `>Bread</a>`, `<p id="summary">1 open</p>`)
	bread := regexp.MustCompile(`<a href="/todos/([^"]+)">Bread</a>`).FindStringSubmatch(r.body)
	if bread == nil {
		t.Fatalf("no Bread row:\n%s", r.body)
	}
	breadID := bread[1]

	// 10b. another user cannot act on a@b.c's todo (C4): `load` checks the page, `update` checks
	// the ids a message carries. b@b.c posts the messages with a@b.c's id: every one is a 404 (a
	// patched not-found page under Datastar), and the row is unchanged.
	b := e.browser()
	if bid := b.loginAs(t, "b@b.c"); bid == uid {
		t.Fatalf("b@b.c has a@b.c's id %q", bid)
	}
	b.do("GET", "/", nil).want(t, 200, `<ul id="todos"></ul>`)
	b.do("GET", "/todos/"+url.PathEscape(breadID), nil).want(t, 404, `<h1>Not found</h1>`)
	q = url.QueryEscape(breadID)
	for _, attack := range []struct {
		path string
		form url.Values
	}{
		{"/_m/Todos.Index/Toggle?id=" + q, nil},
		{"/_m/Todos.Index/Delete?id=" + q, nil},
		{"/_m/Todos.Show/Save?_p.id=" + q, url.Values{"title": {"pwned"}}},
		{"/_m/Todos.Show/Delete?_p.id=" + q, nil},
	} {
		b.do("POST", attack.path, attack.form).want(t, 404, `<h1>Not found</h1>`)
		r = b.do("POST", attack.path, attack.form, datastarHdr)
		r.sse(t)
		r.want(t, 200, `<h1>Not found</h1>`)
	}
	r = e.do("GET", "/", nil)
	r.want(t, 200, `>Done</button></al-button></form><a href="/todos/`+breadID+`">Bread</a>`, `<p id="summary">1 open</p>`)
	r.lacks(t, "pwned")
	// the owner can: Show's messages act on the page's todo (no id of their own)
	r = e.do("GET", "/todos/"+url.PathEscape(breadID), nil)
	save := msgURL(t, r.body, "/_m/Todos.Show/Save", "")
	if save != "/_m/Todos.Show/Save?_p.id="+q {
		t.Fatalf("Show's Save URL %q", save)
	}
	e.do("POST", save, url.Values{"title": {"Rye"}}).redirect(t, "/")
	e.do("GET", "/", nil).want(t, 200, `">Rye</a>`)

	// 11. a tampered cookie (a forged payload under the old signature) is no session
	sess, _ := e.session()
	u, _ := url.Parse(e.srv.URL)
	var good string
	for _, c := range e.c.Jar.Cookies(u) {
		if c.Name == "alder_session" {
			good = c.Value
		}
	}
	// the forged payload is the genuine one with the user id changed, kept under its signature
	sig, genuine := cookiePayload(t, good)
	if !strings.Contains(string(genuine), `"`+sess.User.Val+`"`) {
		t.Fatalf("the genuine payload %s lacks the user id %q", genuine, sess.User.Val)
	}
	forgedPayload := strings.Replace(string(genuine), `"`+sess.User.Val+`"`, `"`+sess.User.Val+`x"`, 1)
	forged := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(forgedPayload)) + "." + sig
	for _, v := range []string{forged, good + "x", "garbage"} {
		req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", e.srv.URL+"/", nil)
		req.AddCookie(&http.Cookie{Name: "alder_session", Value: v})
		res, err := (&http.Client{Timeout: e.c.Timeout, CheckRedirect: e.c.CheckRedirect}).Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		res.Body.Close()
		if res.StatusCode != http.StatusSeeOther || res.Header.Get("Location") != "/login" {
			t.Fatalf("cookie %q: %d %q, want 303 /login", v, res.StatusCode, res.Header.Get("Location"))
		}
	}
	// the genuine cookie still works
	e.do("GET", "/", nil).want(t, 200, `<h1>Todos</h1>`)

	// 12. a failing capability: 500 with App.error, the error text in dev only, its Task's
	// insert rolled back
	before := e.caps.callCount()
	r = e.do("POST", loginSubmit, url.Values{"email": {"boom@b.c"}, "password": {"pw"}})
	r.want(t, 500, `<title>Error</title>`, `<h1>Something went wrong</h1>`, `<p>Please try again.</p>`, `<!-- error: `, `password service down -->`)
	r.html(t)
	r.noCookie(t)
	r = e.do("POST", loginSubmit, url.Values{"email": {"boom@b.c"}, "password": {"pw"}}, datastarHdr)
	r.sse(t)
	r.want(t, 200, `<h1>Something went wrong</h1>`)
	r.noCookie(t)
	r = e.do("POST", loginSubmit, url.Values{"email": {"probe@b.c"}, "password": {"pw"}})
	r.want(t, 200, `Email or password is incorrect.`)
	if got := e.caps.callCount() - before; got != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("Verify called %d times, want 3", got)
	}
	e.caps.mu.Lock()
	probes := append([]int(nil), e.caps.probes...)
	e.caps.mu.Unlock()
	if len(probes) != 2 || probes[0] != 0 || probes[1] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("boom@b.c and a@b.c rows after two failed Tasks = %v, want [0 1] (rolled back; the probe sees committed rows)", probes)
	}
	// the user is still logged in: the failed Task stored no session
	if s, raw := e.session(); s.User.Val != uid {
		t.Fatalf("session after the failure: %s", raw)
	}
	// production: the same page without the error text
	p := newE2E(t, false)
	pr := p.do("GET", "/login", nil)
	r = p.do("POST", msgURL(t, pr.body, "/_m/Auth.Login/Submit", ""), url.Values{"email": {"boom@b.c"}, "password": {"pw"}})
	r.want(t, 500, `<h1>Something went wrong</h1>`, `<p>Please try again.</p>`)
	r.html(t)
	r.lacks(t, "password service down", "<!-- error")

	// 13. App messages (the URL the page renders): Logout redirects to the login page (the app's
	// update says so) with no user
	r = e.do("GET", "/", nil)
	logout := msgURL(t, r.body, "/_m/App/Logout", "")
	r = e.do("POST", logout, nil, datastarHdr)
	r.navigate(t, "/login")
	if s, raw := r.cookieSet(t); s.User.Ok {
		t.Fatalf("session after a Datastar Logout: %s", raw)
	}
	uid2 := e.login(t)
	if uid2 != uid {
		t.Fatalf("logged in again as %q, want %q", uid2, uid)
	}
	r = e.do("POST", logout, nil)
	r.redirect(t, "/login")
	if s, raw := r.cookieSet(t); s.User.Ok {
		t.Fatalf("session after Logout: %s", raw)
	} else {
		t.Logf("session after Logout: %s", raw)
	}
	e.do("GET", "/", nil).redirect(t, "/login")
}
